g.text: Finite construction completeness changes with seed choice
40 nonzero-shift cases per rule: 10 fixtures, shifts 1 and 3, B8/B16.
Exact native/CAS agreement: 120 complete sets, 60 archived baseline sets, 40 empty zero-shift controls.
Different seeds can give different bases. Counts are not time, solver cost, useful-row rank or IC speedup.
